summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Reelax Outreach. Verified onboarding sheet (fresh localStorage), 'Explore with demo data' skip flow, localStorage persistence across reload, 5-item sidebar navigation (Campaigns/Quick Send/Inbox/Messages/Results), Settings drawer with ESC close, QuickSend sandbox (paste parsing, invalid-input toast, dedup add, Send button state and text, real Meta API template dropdown populated with 10 approved templates), Inbox empty state, Messages page with new-template modal button, Results page, Campaigns hub rows, Campaign detail (back + send-again + 5 metrics), SendDrawer wizard (send-name, send-next, 3 selectable audience-collection rows). All required data-testid attributes present. No JS console errors observed (only vite HMR debug + React devtools info).
critical_code_review_comments: QuickSendPage recipients state is local component state — if user navigates away from Quick Send and back, the recipient list is lost. Consider persisting to store if desired.

In QuickSendPage.runSend loop, per-recipient variable substitution uses the same `samples` map for every recipient — CSV per-row variable mapping (mentioned in file comment on line 194) is not actually implemented; all recipients receive identical rendered body. Fine for a sandbox but should be documented.
OnboardingSheet 'Explore with demo data' link is not tagged with a stable data-testid; testing had to rely on button text. Add data-testid='onboarding-skip' for future stability.
CampaignDetail Metric labeled 'Read / Opened' contains a space+slash which can break simple substring checks; kept as-is since it's a display string.
seed_data_creation: none - used 'Explore with demo data' onboarding path which seeds a demo WA number via connectWhatsApp action; app already ships with 5 demo campaigns and 3 collections in the store.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a Vite SPA at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preview. To reset state, use page.evaluate('localStorage.clear()') then reload. Meta API at api.dev.getreelax.com does return approved templates (11 options observed including placeholder). Do not click quicksend-send with real numbers – it would hit the live API.
